specification_purpose: Fix the operator procedure of the single authorized v2 confirmatory run, so that the session that executes it follows a preregistered procedure instead of improvising one after the single-use confirmatory window has been burned. The runbook records rules only; it authorizes nothing, fetches nothing, reads no candle and writes no confirmatory artifact.

applies_to.evaluation_window_rule: The evaluated window is exactly the first minimum_closed_hourly_candles closed hourly candles at or after the window start, so it ends at the earliest instant the frozen boundary allows. The evaluated window's length does not depend on when the run happens, and the window may not be extended, shortened or re-based at run time.

code_identity.note: The identity of the run is the composite of the canonical digest of the hashed v1 engine and the canonical digest of the confirmatory execution path. The checkout-dependent ordered digest compute_code_hash() is an environment fact and is never used as an identity.

global_rules: the run is a single logical run: it may be resumed, never restarted
every step is fail-closed: a step that cannot prove its precondition stops the run
nothing is repaired: a mismatch is reported, not corrected
every read of the window is counted in holdout_exposed_count
no step contacts a provider except the readiness probe and the single retrieval

ordered_steps.name: PREFLIGHT
ordered_steps.action: Confirm, before anything else, that the commit carrying this runbook, the authorization, the confirmatory protocol and the protocol amendment exists; that the live code identity equals the recorded composite identity; that the five v1 evidence files and the six v2 selection outputs are byte-unchanged against their recorded sha256 anchors; that the evaluation scope equals the frozen selected-configurations manifest (14 in scope, 4 out of scope); and that holdout_exposed_count is 0, or that this process is the resume of the same run_id.
may_not: read a candle
contact the provider
write any confirmatory artifact
ordered_steps.on_failure: stop and report; the run is refused by the authorization's preconditions and no attempt is consumed

ordered_steps.name: READINESS_PROBE
ordered_steps.action: Run the metadata-only readiness probe: one bounded request per metadata endpoint, the primary host first and the documented failover host only when the primary host fails, with both statuses and their timestamps recorded. The probe returns the provider server time and the spot trading status of the in-scope pairs. It fetches no candle and it does not increment holdout_exposed_count.
may_not: fetch a candle or any kline payload
read the window to count its candles
increment holdout_exposed_count
ordered_steps.on_failure: the readiness test refuses the run (WindowNotReadyError): the window cannot end before the earliest possible end, or an in-scope pair is not trading. Abort before the first payload read; the attempt is released and the window is untouched.

ordered_steps.name: SINGLE_RETRIEVAL
ordered_steps.action: Retrieve the window once: for every in-scope asset, in ascending symbol order, one klines request over the fixed window bounds. The window is the first minimum_closed_hourly_candles closed hourly candles at or after the window start, so its length does not depend on when the run happens. Each dataset is filtered to the closed candles that open and close inside the window; the coverage gaps are recorded; nothing is interpolated and no malformed row is repaired.
may_not: read the window twice
extend, shorten or re-base the window at run time
interpolate a missing candle
read a candle outside the window
ordered_steps.on_failure: a provider or rate-limit failure is retried within the frozen retry budget and then resumed; an abort after a payload read leaves the window spent

ordered_steps.name: DATASET_PERSISTENCE_AND_EXPOSURE
ordered_steps.action: Persist every retrieved dataset in the canonical hourly CSV of the frozen sha256-canonical-hourly-csv-v1 scheme, next to a record that binds it to (run_id, asset, window bounds) and to its content hash. Recompute the content hash of every persisted dataset and compare it with the recorded one. Register the exposure event for the asset exactly once, and check that the exposure counter never decreases.
may_not: increment the exposure counter twice for the same event
reset the exposure counter
repair a dataset whose hash does not match
ordered_steps.on_failure: a hash mismatch is refused and reported; the window is not re-read, because a re-read would be a second read of a single-use window

ordered_steps.name: WINDOW_MANIFEST
ordered_steps.action: Build the window manifest: the window bounds, the retrieval timestamp, the per-asset dataset hashes, the closed-candle count per asset, the coverage gaps, the exposure events and the readiness record, bound to the frozen v2 data manifest and to the selected-configurations manifest. The frozen v2 data manifest is extended by reference and never edited.
may_not: edit the v2 data manifest
omit an asset of the scope from the manifest
ordered_steps.on_failure: abort; the window manifest is the evidence of the read

ordered_steps.name: PRECONDITION_RECHECK
ordered_steps.action: Re-evaluate the authorization's preconditions (a) to (f) with the readiness record, the window manifest and the exposure state in hand. The run stops if any precondition fails.
may_not: continue with a failed precondition
ordered_steps.on_failure: raise AuthorizationError; the rollback rule of the failure table applies

ordered_steps.name: EVALUATION
ordered_steps.action: Evaluate every in-scope asset's frozen configuration over the window with the unchanged v1 evaluation metric and the unchanged cost scenarios. The evaluated parameters are byte-identical to the frozen candidate manifest entry. The buy-and-hold baseline is computed over the same window at the baseline costs, which costs no additional exposure.
may_not: re-tune, re-rank or extend the grid on the window
evaluate a configuration that is not the frozen one
evaluate the four assets without a candidate
ordered_steps.on_failure: report the asset as INCONCLUSIVE or REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT, never hide it

ordered_steps.name: VERDICT
ordered_steps.action: Grade every asset with the frozen specification's promotion rule, which governs. The protocol's buy-and-hold criterion is computed and reported beside it, and a disagreement is disclosed as criteria_agreement. The status vocabulary is not extended: PROVISIONAL_HISTORICAL_SURVIVAL, REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT, INCONCLUSIVE and CANDIDATE_PENDING_HOLDOUT only.
may_not: grade the outcome with a rule other than the amendment's precedence
extend the frozen status vocabulary
hide an asset, a disagreement or a null result
ordered_steps.on_failure: the null result is reported as NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVED_THE_CONFIRMATORY_RULE

ordered_steps.name: WRITE_OUTPUT_LAYOUT
ordered_steps.action: Write the eight authorized output paths in the fixed order, atomically, so that a partial write is never observable as a complete artifact.
may_not: write a v1 path
write a v2 selection path
write the output layout in another order
ordered_steps.on_failure: the rollback rule of the failure table applies

ordered_steps.name: ACCEPTANCE
ordered_steps.action: Run the acceptance checks of this runbook and the verification commands below, and record their exit statuses in the handoff before the result is accepted.
may_not: accept the output without running the acceptance checks
ordered_steps.on_failure: the output is not accepted; the failure is reported

endpoints.purpose: spot trading status of the in-scope pairs

readiness_probe.failover_policy: One bounded request to the primary host. If it fails (for example HTTP 451), use the documented failover host and record both statuses with timestamps. The primary host is failed over, not blindly retried. max_retries applies to transient failures on the active endpoint only.

retrieval.dataset_persistence: the canonical hourly CSV next to a record that binds it to (run_id, asset, window bounds) and to its content hash, under the shard directory of the run

evaluation.authoritative_criterion: configs/research_v2.json#holdout.promotion_rule, as reconciled by the protocol amendment

write_order.content: the window bounds, the retrieval timestamp, the per-asset dataset hashes, the closed-candle counts, the coverage gaps, the exposure events and the readiness record
the per-asset result rows, one shard file of the confirmatory campaign
the result rows as a single JSONL stream, the projection of the shard
the run identity, the scope, the per-asset outcomes, the exposure state and the counts
the shard list with their sha256, the code identity and the window-manifest hash
the run status and the exposure counter, which must never be reset
the confirmatory report: the required fields, every per-asset outcome and the criteria disclosure
the human-readable rendering of the report

failure_decision_table.detection: the pre-flight, the readiness probe or the precondition re-check fails
failure_decision_table.response: roll back every artifact the run created, leave holdout_exposed_count at 0 and release the attempt
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: none: the window was never read
failure_decision_table.resumable: the single authorized attempt is still available
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the abort reason in the handoff

failure_decision_table.detection: the run fails after the first dataset has been read
failure_decision_table.response: record the run as EXPOSED_ABORTED, keep the exposure in place, keep the already retrieved and hash-verified datasets, and resume the same run from them; never read the window again
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: the exposure stays: the window is spent
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the confirmatory checkpoint records EXPOSED_ABORTED and the exposure events; no report is produced
failure_decision_table.resumable: yes, as a resume of the same run, bounded by max_retries_on_technical_failure
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the report must state that the window was consumed without a completed evaluation

failure_decision_table.detection: a transport error, a timeout, HTTP 429 or another retryable status
failure_decision_table.response: fail over a host failure to the documented failover host and record both statuses; retry a transient failure on the active endpoint within the frozen retry budget with the frozen backoff, then resume the run
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: a read that returned a payload is counted; a failed request is not
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the verified datasets of the completed assets are kept for the resume
failure_decision_table.resumable: yes, within the frozen retry budget
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the provider statuses with their timestamps in the handoff

failure_decision_table.detection: the recomputed content hash of a persisted dataset differs from the recorded one
failure_decision_table.response: refuse the dataset; do not repair it, do not re-fetch it and do not re-read the window, because a re-read would be a second read of a single-use window
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: the read is counted: the window is spent
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the run is recorded as EXPOSED_ABORTED and the mismatch is reported
failure_decision_table.resumable: no: the resume may only reuse a hash-verified dataset
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the mismatch, the asset and the two digests

failure_decision_table.detection: the readiness probe reports a pair that is not trading, or a retrieved dataset holds fewer closed candles than the window requires
failure_decision_table.response: a pair that is not trading refuses the whole run in the readiness step, before any candle is read; an insufficient dataset is refused for its asset, recorded with its gaps and never interpolated
failure_decision_table.exposure_effect: the readiness refusal exposes nothing; an insufficient dataset is a read
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the asset is reported as INCONCLUSIVE with its gap record
failure_decision_table.resumable: a readiness refusal is retryable; a spent window is not
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the pair status or the gap record, per asset

failure_decision_table.detection: the evaluation yields no closed trade, or the promotion rule does not hold
failure_decision_table.response: grade the asset with the frozen status vocabulary: INCONCLUSIVE for the zero-trade case, REJECTED_ON_HOLDOUT for a failing asset. Report it.
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the asset appears in the report with its verdict and its reason
failure_decision_table.reported_as: the per-asset outcome in the report and in the ledger

failure_decision_table.detection: no asset of the frozen scope reaches PROVISIONAL_HISTORICAL_SURVIVAL
failure_decision_table.response: report the null result as NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVED_THE_CONFIRMATORY_RULE; it is a legitimate outcome of the run and is never hidden or re-run
failure_decision_table.artifact_state: the report carries the null outcome and every per-asset verdict

checks.check: the run's exit status and the handoff record the executed command and its exit status
checks.how: operator records the command line and the exit status in the session handoff

checks.check: the confirmatory path verifier passes on the delivered tree
the full test suite is green
the exposure count reconciles across the three records
checks.how: the window manifest, the confirmatory checkpoint and the report carry the same holdout_exposed_count, and it equals the number of exposure events

checks.check: the window manifest's self-hash recomputes and every dataset hash verifies
checks.how: recompute the manifest hash over the document body and the content hash of every persisted dataset

checks.check: the result stream is the projection of the shard
checks.how: the sha256 of the shard bytes equals the sha256 of the result stream

checks.check: the ledger, the results manifest and the report agree with the run identity
checks.how: the run_code_identity, the authorization manifest hash, the window-manifest hash and the per-asset outcomes are identical in the three records

checks.check: the v1 evidence and the v2 selection outputs are byte-unchanged
checks.how: recompute the sha256 of the five v1 evidence files and the six v2 selection outputs and compare them with the authorization's recorded anchors

checks.check: no v1 or v2 selection path was written and no confirmatory row entered the v1 result stream
checks.how: git status over the forbidden paths and a scan of research/results.jsonl

checks.check: every asset of the frozen scope appears in the report, including the four without a candidate
checks.how: the report's per_asset_outcomes and assets_without_candidate fields

verification_commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "from breakout_research import config; print(config.compute_code_hash())"
the_output_is_accepted_only_when: the handoff records the commands, their exit statuses and the per-asset outcome

prohibitions: the run may not read the confirmatory window twice
the run may not rank, re-rank, re-tune or select anything on the confirmatory window
the run may not extend, shorten or re-base the grid, the window or the cost scenarios
the run may not write a v1 path
the run may not write a v2 selection path
the run may not mix the 497,664 selection units with the confirmatory results, and the two are never tallied with
the run may not grade the outcome with a rule other than the amendment's precedence
the run may not open the v1 holdout
the run may not reset or decrease holdout_exposed_count
the run may not evaluate an asset outside the frozen scope, nor re-evaluate an asset that has no candidate
the run may not be started before the commit that carries the runbook and the authorization exists
the run may not be started before the confirmatory window can end
a completed run is never re-run; an interrupted run is resumed, never restarted

durability.rule: The runbook is preregistered by being committed. The confirmatory run may not start before the commit that carries this runbook and the authorization exists, and it may not start before the window can end.
durability.note: The commit hash is recorded by the committing session. This artifact is not rewritten after that commit, because its manifest_hash must not change.

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the document body with manifest_hash removed, so the document does not hash itself into a cycle.
